name: STAR Link — range, range rate and one-way Doppler shift
summary: Range and range rate between two states and the frequency received over that link, by the longitudinal relativistic formula or the first-order one; on 600 pairs of states and range rates up to 0.9 c the results agree with NAIF SPICE (vnorm, dvnorm), astropy's Doppler equivalencies, NumPy and mpmath at 40 digits within 8.3e-16 of their natural scale.
reference: speed of light 299792.458 km/s (SI definition); by hand: a source receding at 0.6 c is received at sqrt(0.4/1.6) = 0.5 of its frequency

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: range rate positive when the two move apart; a positive range rate lowers the received frequency; km and km/s with C_KM_S
review.G-06: one constant (the SI speed of light); cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input, for coincident positions and for a range rate at or beyond the speed of light; the omissions (light time, two-way, transverse term, media) are stated with their order of magnitude
